Q6176.reason: Pointing the gun and demanding money was a substantial step toward robbery by intimidation, so it is attempted robbery; the owner’s knowledge that the gun was unloaded negates apprehension assault, and there was no intent to commit a battery.

Q6177.reason: The owner’s out-of-court assertion is offered to prove the envelope actually contained the notice, which is hearsay, and a party cannot admit their own statement as a party-opponent admission or under any other exception.
